title: Cheap Custom Jerseys (2026)
verdict: The way to get cheap custom jerseys in 2026 is to buy made-to-order jerseys at team quantity. At Wooter the price per jersey falls sharply as the order grows, the design is free, and with sublimation extra colors cost nothing.

For a handful of jerseys, Custom Ink's printed stock jerseys with free shipping can cost less. Boombah advertises no setup fees, design fees or minimums. Champro and Nike Team prices depend on the dealer.

ranking.fit: Teams and leagues of ten or more that want a real custom jersey at the lowest price per player.
ranking.lacks: Not the cheapest for one or two jerseys. Single pieces cost several times the team price.
ranking.note: When we checked in November 2026, Wooter's crew neck soccer jersey cost $43.74 each for 1 to 9, $34.99 for 51 to 100 and $14.99 at 1,001 or more.

ranking.fit: Very small orders where a printed stock jersey is enough.
ranking.lacks: Mostly stock garments with your print added, not a jersey built from your pattern.

ranking.fit: Teams that want sublimated uniforms with no setup or design fees.
ranking.lacks: Lead times and minimums differ from page to page on its site.

ranking.fit: Programs that order through a local team dealer and want cut-and-sew sublimation.
ranking.lacks: Orders go through a dealer account. There is no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and work with an authorized dealer.

why: Cheap and custom pull in opposite directions until you understand where the cost is. Most of it is setup and labor, which are the same for one jersey as for fifty. Spread across a team, they nearly disappear.
Five things lower the price: order more at once, choose sublimation so colors are free, pick reversibles in place of home and away, skip names if you do not need them, and sell a sponsor spot.
What does not lower the price is the cheapest fabric. A jersey that fades by midseason is bought twice.

faq.q: How much do cheap custom jerseys cost?
faq.a: It depends on sport and quantity, and the price falls as the order grows. As one example, Wooter's crew neck soccer jersey ran from $43.74 each for 1 to 9 pieces down to $14.99 at 1,001 or more when we checked in November 2026.

faq.q: Why is a single jersey expensive?
faq.a: Setup and labor are fixed. One jersey carries all of it.
Cheaper than buying a home and an away jersey for each player.

A local business pays for a logo on the jersey. Many rec teams cover most of their cost this way.
